projects.title: MindSpace
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Mental Wellness Platform
projects.summary: Context-aware mental health support assistant ('Mimi') powered by custom RAG pipelines and a hybrid database architecture.
bullets: Built 'Mimi', an AI chatbot providing context-aware mental health support, using a custom RAG pipeline and Pinecone for vector storage.
Designed a hybrid database (MySQL & MongoDB) to guarantee ACID compliance for user data while scaling chat logs for 100+ concurrent sessions.
Constrained LLM outputs exclusively to verified psychological datasets, mitigating hallucinations and ensuring medically safe user interactions.
Secured a Top 100 finish among 500+ teams and 3,000+ participants at MumbaiHacks 2025.
projects.problem: Mental health chatbots frequently suffer from hallucinations or ungrounded medical advice, while existing architectures struggle to balance strict transactional compliance with unstructured chat logs.
projects.architecture: Custom RAG Pipeline + Pinecone Vector Store + Ollama Local LLM + MySQL (User ACID transactions) + MongoDB (Chat history logs).
projects.key_decisions: Enforced strict context constraints using verified psychological reference datasets; isolated relational user profile state from non-relational chat streams.
projects.results: Top 100 finish out of 500+ teams; 100+ concurrent session throughput with zero medical hallucinations.

projects.title: IntelliDocs
projects.subtitle: AI Document Analysis System
projects.summary: Secure document analysis pipeline leveraging local compute tunneling and TiDB vector search for zero-cost document intelligence.
bullets: Launched on AWS Lightsail, acquiring 50+ signups by engineering a secure tunneling architecture to route heavy LLM inference to local compute, bypassing cloud hardware limits.
Architected a robust data pipeline using PyMuPDF for text extraction and Cloudinary for file management, converting documents into vector embeddings in TiDB with page-level metadata.
Automated document summarization using Local LLMs (Ollama), processing complex files while entirely eliminating external API costs.
projects.problem: Cloud-hosted LLM APIs incur steep per-token costs and impose memory constraints on free/low-tier instances when parsing multi-page technical documents.
projects.architecture: AWS Lightsail + Local Tunneling (Ollama Inference) + PyMuPDF + TiDB Vector Embeddings + Cloudinary File Storage.
projects.key_decisions: Decoupled cloud frontend/storage from compute-intensive LLM inference via secure tunneling, driving external API cost down to $0.
projects.results: 50+ active signups; processed 100+ multi-page PDFs with zero external API fees.
